assets.alt: Pengurus putra sekolah Islam menelaah laporan keuangan dengan teliti
assets.caption: Amanah menjadi lebih kuat ketika keputusan dapat ditopang bukti dan laporan yang dapat dijelaskan.
assets.scene: Two Indonesian Muslim male school trustees in modest batik shirts, one with black peci, thoughtfully checking a financial report in a bright Islamic school office. Side view, reports and neat folders foreground, courtyard visible behind; calm professional interaction.

assets.alt: Pengelola putri memetakan unit sekolah dan periode pelaporan
assets.caption: Batas entitas dan periode ditetapkan sebelum saldo dari berbagai unit digabungkan.
assets.scene: One Indonesian Muslim female school finance coordinator in a long deep teal khimar covering her chest and shoulders and loose full-length clothing, standing beside a pinboard with a simple blank branching unit map and separate calendar cards. Three-quarter wide view, airy school planning room.

assets.alt: Petugas putra menelusuri arsip dan daftar saldo awal sekolah
assets.caption: Pembenahan dimulai dari saldo yang dapat diverifikasi, bukan dari menghapus kewajiban masa lalu.
assets.scene: One Indonesian Muslim male school accountant in a modest earth-tone shirt, checking an older document archive against a tablet at a wooden desk. Open numbered binders, asset photograph and receipts arranged carefully. Intimate over-the-shoulder camera, realistic organized archive room, no readable personal information.

assets.alt: Petugas putri menata bukti transaksi dan kode akun
assets.caption: Nomor transaksi menghubungkan bukti, persetujuan, buku besar, dan laporan.
assets.scene: Indonesian Muslim female administrator wearing a very long navy khimar draped over chest and shoulders with loose sleeves, hands sorting receipts into colored folders beside a laptop. Close elevated desk view with her clearly visible modest attire, Islamic school office; neat physical trail from receipt to binder, no legible names or amounts.

assets.alt: Bendahara putra memilah dokumen sumber dana dan kewajiban sekolah
assets.caption: Setiap penerimaan perlu dibaca menurut hak, pembatasan, dan kewajiban yang menyertainya.
assets.scene: Indonesian Muslim male school treasurer alone at a large desk with three distinct trays holding donation letter, service agreement and student custody register represented by unobtrusive blank cover sheets. Wide diagonal composition, notebook and calculator, warm school administration setting; emphasize careful classification rather than cash piles.

assets.alt: Pengelola putri mencocokkan register beasiswa dan bukti penyaluran
assets.caption: Pelepasan pembatasan menjelaskan penggunaan dana tanpa menciptakan penghasilan kedua.
assets.scene: Two Indonesian Muslim women both wearing long khimars covering chest and shoulders and loose long dresses, one in muted sage one in navy, reviewing scholarship disbursement evidence and a donor register in an Islamic school office. Seated across a broad desk, generous personal space; softly lit side profile, no male people.

assets.alt: Petugas putra menandai periode layanan pada daftar penerimaan SPP
assets.caption: Waktu penerimaan uang dan periode pengakuan penghasilan tidak selalu sama.
assets.scene: One Indonesian Muslim male administrator in modest batik at a desk, using a pen to connect payment entries to a monthly service calendar. Laptop and two calendar blocks, natural window light, over-the-shoulder composition, Islamic school corridor in background, all private data abstract and unreadable.

assets.alt: Panitia putri menyelesaikan laporan pertanggungjawaban kegiatan
assets.caption: Pertanggungjawaban kegiatan menyelesaikan uang muka melalui bukti realisasi dan pengembalian sisa.
assets.scene: Two Indonesian Muslim female school committee staff both in extra-long chest-covering khimars and loose modest clothing, finalizing an activity accountability folder with receipts and a sealed return envelope at a wide worktable. One checks a list, the other files evidence; medium-wide candid angle, no male people or cash counting glamour.

assets.alt: Petugas putra memeriksa inventaris komputer dan register aset sekolah
assets.caption: Register aset menghubungkan keberadaan barang, biaya perolehan, sumber dana, dan penyusutannya.
assets.scene: One Indonesian Muslim male school asset custodian with modest shirt and trousers checking a desktop computer inventory tag using a clipboard in an empty Islamic school computer lab. Wide aisle camera, orderly equipment, afternoon light, inventory responsibility theme, no students or women.

assets.alt: Bendahara putri merekonsiliasi rekening koran dengan buku besar
assets.caption: Tutup buku menggabungkan rekonsiliasi, penyesuaian, dan pemeriksaan yang meninggalkan jejak.
assets.scene: One Indonesian Muslim woman in a long chest-covering sand-colored khimar and loose full-length outfit comparing a generic bank statement with ledger on laptop, calculator at side. Focused eye-level medium shot, bright modest Islamic school finance office, no readable bank details, uncluttered composition.

assets.alt: Akuntan putra menyusun lima komponen laporan yang saling terhubung
assets.caption: Posisi keuangan, hasil periode, perubahan aset neto, arus kas, dan catatan harus saling cocok.
assets.scene: One Indonesian Muslim male accountant in modest navy batik at a broad table arranging five report folios with generic tables and simple charts, laptop showing a balanced abstract spreadsheet. Elevated wide angle clearly distinguishes five documents without tiny readable text, professional Islamic school setting, no other people.

assets.alt: Pimpinan putri menelaah kas tersedia dan rencana layanan pendidikan
assets.caption: Keputusan mempertimbangkan kas, jatuh tempo, pembatasan dana, dan keberlanjutan layanan sekaligus.
assets.scene: Two Indonesian Muslim female school leaders both in long chest-covering khimars and loose modest clothing, reviewing a simple cash projection chart at a large meeting table. One gestures gently toward upcoming needs calendar, other takes notes, school garden through window, wide side angle, no males.

assets.alt: Petugas putra menghubungkan laporan program dengan buku besar
assets.caption: Berbagai laporan khusus berasal dari catatan dasar yang sama, dengan perbedaan yang dapat dijelaskan.
assets.scene: One Indonesian Muslim male school finance officer alone at an administration desk comparing four separate folders for program reporting beside a master ledger. Tidy document bridge arrangement, laptop, filing cabinet and subtle Islamic geometric architectural detail, medium diagonal view, no readable fiscal forms or official logos.

assets.alt: Tim putri menyusun kalender pemeriksaan dan rencana pembenahan keuangan
assets.caption: Sistem yang solid dapat diulang, diperiksa, dan diteruskan oleh petugas berikutnya.
assets.scene: Three Indonesian Muslim female school administrators all wearing extra-long khimars fully covering chest and shoulders and loose long garments, standing with generous spacing at a planning wall with a simple three-stage timeline and checklist cards. Varied navy sage cream attire, bright Islamic school office, hopeful candid wide shot, no male people.
